title: Resisting Gender Violence
description: Gender violence occurs within every country and cultural context, affecting women, girls, and LGBTQIA+ people of all racial, ethnic, religious, socioeconomic, ability, and age groups. Gender violence is one of the most pervasive human rights violations in the world. With contributing authors from across Europe, Africa, Asia, and the Americas, Resisting Gender Violence represents a truly global perspective.
authors: Susan M. Shaw - Editor / Xosé M. Santos - Editor / Jayamala Mayilsamy - Editor / Kamalaveni Veni - Editor / Laura Pallarés Ameneiro - Editor / Zenetta Rosaline - Editor / Janet Lockhart - Editor
